title: Dashboard
subtitle: What is going out, and what needs attention.

onboarding.noAccountBody: Connect a network to start publishing.

network.title: Connect a network
network.hint: Steerpost publishes to the accounts you connect. Pick LinkedIn, Telegram or another network.

post.title: Write your first post
post.hint: Save a draft or schedule it. Nothing is published until you say so.

agent.title: Connect an AI agent
agent.hint: Create an MCP connection or an API key so Claude or your own scripts can draft posts for you.

approval.title: Review an approval
approval.hint: When an agent asks to publish, delete or disconnect, the request waits here.
